purpose: Stable acceptance criteria for the three neutral source categories required by THEF-16. Expectations are source-independent: derived only from the Swift/ObjC source semantics, not from any migrated app. Each AC has a total denominator, an independent oracle, and an honest verification status.

swiftui_binding_navigation.summary: SwiftUI @State identity + two-way @Binding across NavigationStack (SwitchRow toggle, Detail Disable button).

acs.expectation: enabled starts false; one Toggle flip -> true; second flip -> false (single shared source).
Detail 'Disable' writes false back to the shared binding (cross-navigation write-back).
Toggle is a real flip, not a constant; repeated toggle alternates.

uikit_objc_event_resource.summary: UIKit/ObjC viewDidLoad init + IBAction add: wired to button touchUpInside + countLabel outlet.

acs.expectation: load -> count 0 / 'Count: 0'; each tap -> +1 and label 'Count: N'.
Business increment is exactly +1; +2 mutant must be rejected.
countLabel outlet wiring preserved; silent label loss must be detected.

async_cancel_persist_exception.summary: ObservableObject save Task with cancellation, UserDefaults persistence, and typed error branches.

acs.expectation: add then save (no cancel) -> 'Saved' and savedCount persisted.
save then cancel before write -> 'Cancelled', nothing persisted.
cancellation must protect persistence; disabled cancel mutant rejected.
persistence target not silently dropped; missing prefs.set detected.

honest_limits.note: Host oracles execute the actual authored target .ets logic via DevEco TypeScript transpile + Node vm. They verify business semantics and discriminate mutants; they do NOT claim ArkUI rendering or device pass.
